claim_boundary: Three-seed probability ensemble on simulation-only grouped splits. Calibration uses only the combined P0b/P0d validation plus optional grouped targeted calibration. P1v2 is never loaded. It is not a real-robot posterior or closed-loop performance proof.
direction_role: allow bounded transport only when all calibrated set/concentration/disagreement gates pass
fallback: guarded local outward spiral or re-probe
state_role: soft action-relevant radial likelihood only: combine calibrated support-state probabilities with approximate CAD using a nonzero likelihood floor; never use a hard state gate, direct distance command, capture trigger, or terminal verifier
